name: Taihou Daigaku Byouin no Kyouki  - Dai San Ya
original_name: 大鳳大学病院の狂気 第三夜
source:
The punishments being doled out to Rieko's beloved Kaho just keep getting worse.

Finally, Kaho becomes the property of a rich family...by having a mark burned into her flesh with a soldering iron.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE040233.html]DLsite English[/url]]
